messages:
emma_support: FYI — customer INV-9921 autopay failed twice this morning. They see a decline inside the payment iframe during the ACS step. Gateway logs show first = `insufficient_funds`, second = `challenge_required`.
emma_support: Customer is on Chrome 117 (desktop). They said the iframe briefly flashes then shows an error, no challenge UI. Need repro steps and quick mitigation — renewal is EOD.
raj_payments: can you paste the gateway request_id and whether this was a saved card or one-off PO payment?
emma_support: request_id=gw_0a1b2c3d4e5, payment_method=customer_saved_card, merchant has PO flag but autopay enabled for invoices. Attached a small HAR and console.txt from the customer.
olivia_eng: quick scan — HAR shows ACS responded with a 302/Location to the ACS challenge page and also sent `Set-Cookie: session=...; SameSite=Lax`. If the ACS expects top-level navigation, Chrome may block the redirect inside an iframe (SameSite/Lax + cross-site). That could explain no visible challenge.
raj_payments: if ACS requires top-level, our iframe flow won't surface the challenge. Short term: turn off autopay for that merchant or set their merchant config to `redirect_on_challenge=true` so users are navigated out of the iframe.
emma_support: @raj — can you flip that for INV-9921's merchant? Customer asked for a same-day workaround.
raj_payments: doing it now. Patch ID: MCFG-7891. I've set `redirect_on_challenge=true` for merchant acme_co for the next 24h. Also flagged PAY-3412 to track a proper fix.
devops-bot: Ticket created: PAY-3412 — "ACS challenge blocked in iframe due to SameSite cookie / top-level redirect" assigned to olivia_eng.
olivia_eng: taking PAY-3412. Plan: reproduce with headless Chrome using the same Request and Set-Cookie behavior and with cross-site iframe. If we can reproduce, we'll add a clearer gateway-level error `acs_navigation_blocked` and recommend redirect flow to merchant console.
olivia_eng: also note: some ACS providers set `X-Frame-Options: DENY` or CSP frame-ancestors which will always break iframe flow. We'll add a detection path to fallback to redirect instead of failing silently.
emma_support: Great — I'll update the customer that autopay workaround is applied and ops can manually retry. Anything else you need from them?
raj_payments: pls ask for full HAR and browser console if it happens again, and the time of failure. I logged the gateway request IDs and responses in PAY-3412.
emma_support: Will do. Thanks team :thumbsup:
